name: Render Lock And Synchronization Audit

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown:
## Render Lock And Synchronization Audit Hypothesis

Gpux may acquire shared mutexes or read-write locks repeatedly inside warmed per-glyph, per-primitive, or per-node render loops even though rendering is UI-thread-owned; tracing lock sites can identify a bounded ownership simplification.

**Attempt Count:** 1.

### Scope Lock

Read-only inventory of Mutex/RwLock acquisition sites reachable from text paint, atlas lookup, renderer draw, layout, scene insertion, and WASM frame dispatch. No edits.
measurementPlanMarkdown:
### Measurement Plan

Classify hot-path locks by acquisition frequency, protected owner, cross-thread requirement, and whether a lock is held across callbacks or asynchronous boundaries. Cross-check against the current CPU profile and prior lock-removal experiments.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown:
### Expected Outcome

Select one measured lock-removal candidate or preserve locks whose cross-thread ownership is required and whose cost is not profile-visible.

measurements.after: 1 TextSystem raster-bounds RwLock acquisition and 1 WgpuAtlas Mutex acquisition per visible cached glyph/sprite
measurements.delta: locks are short, uncontended cache lookups; platform text-system write locks are reached only on cache/atlas misses

measurements.after: 1 std::sync::Mutex acquisition per frame to take asynchronous device error state
measurements.delta: required bridge from the WGPU uncaptured-error callback; no lock is held through command encoding or submission

measurements.after: current/previous line-layout caches use read/upgradable/write locks per lookup or rollover; the pooled line-wrapper mutex is acquired only for active truncation after prior optimization
measurements.delta: current CPU profile attributes hot time to Taffy/layout/draw functions rather than lock primitives

measurements.after: dispatcher/timer/priority-queue locks guard cross-thread queues and are released before runnable execution or await boundaries
measurements.delta: no synchronous render lock was found held across await

reportMarkdown:
## Render Lock And Synchronization Audit Finished

**Passed Status:** true. The warmed paint path performs short, uncontended shared-cache locks for raster bounds and atlas tiles. Backend text write locks occur only on cache misses. Renderer error polling is one lock per frame; scheduling and entity/focus locks enforce real cross-thread or shared-handle ownership. No synchronous render lock was found held across an async boundary, and lock primitives are not current CPU profile leaders.

**Attempt Count:** 1.

### Scope Lock

Only lock declarations/acquisition sites and their immediate ownership/call paths were inspected. No production source or adjacent concurrency behavior changed.

decisionMarkdown:
### Decision

Preserve current locks. Removing the two per-glyph cache locks requires a separate ownership/cache fusion design and measurement; the current evidence does not justify weakening cross-thread cache safety. Keep the already accepted truncation-only wrapper checkout and thread-local font-run scratch optimizations.
